wholePhysicalScope: Named five-node OpenStreetMap way 314217096 provides the main external outline and 17 storeys at Jalan Kianggeh. The Brunei Malay Teachers Association independently identifies the address and 17-storey replacement.
lodDetails: Four detail levels keep the 17-storey profile and articulated podium. Near levels show fins, entry and glazing divisions.
limitations: Present 17-storey replacement only. It opened on the same site as the 1965 teachers’ building.
The lower envelope follows the exact native outline. The upper footprint, setbacks, roof height, entry, cladding, glazing and window rhythms are architectural estimates.
